title: delphinium orientale var. hispanicum
intro: Delphinium orientale var. hispanicum, commonly known as the Spanish delphinium, is a perennial plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. The Spanish delphinium has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory conditions, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to act as a bronchodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, helping to relieve symptoms associated with respiratory issues and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Spanish delphinium include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
